description: Booths and vendors at an event: name, category, booth number, the printed aisle where the floor has them ("Water Side"), and a short blurb. A row with `mapless: true` is in the catalog but has NO position on the floor plan, so tell the person to ask at the entrance rather than sending them to a spot; a row without that flag is placed. Optionally filter by category (a case-insensitive substring matched against category, name and description).

boothNameOrId.description: Optional booth id or name: returns that one booth's full card instead of the list

eventIdOrSlug.description: Event id, public slug, or the event name as events_list spells it; short forms such as "the stroll" work.

name: events_booths
title: List booths and vendors
